CheckTitle: Check if EFS protects sensitive data with encryption at rest
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Description: Checks that EFS file systems are encrypted at rest.
Risk: Unencrypted file systems expose data at rest; EFS encryption cannot be enabled after creation.

Recommendation.Text: Create a new encrypted file system, migrate data with DataSync, and delete the unencrypted one.
